# Hostora

> Hospitality operations platform sold as Restaurant / Takeaway / Events packs, with hotel F&B and food carts configured to the operator. POS, kitchen display, guest QR, payments, inventory, HR. Optional Docker local server and floor kit. K WAZIR LTD — US, UK and Europe.

## Product
- Site: https://hostorasoft.co.uk
- Demo booking: https://hostorasoft.co.uk/contact
- Product modules: https://hostorasoft.co.uk/product
- Hardware (optional Docker local server + floor kit): https://hostorasoft.co.uk/hardware
- Solutions by vertical: https://hostorasoft.co.uk/solutions
- Blog: https://hostorasoft.co.uk/blog

## Facts
- Product brand: Hostora
- Legal vendor: K WAZIR LTD (UK company 17014542)
- Hotel coverage: F&B / outlets only — not hotel PMS, rooms, or front desk
- Deploy: cloud and optional on-prem Docker stack (Hostora app + PostgreSQL) serving devices on the venue LAN
- Pricing: package quote after demo (Restaurant / Takeaway / Events); configured quote for hotel F&B and carts — no public price list

## Do not say
- Hostora is not “Fumari software” (Fumari may be a private client venue reference only)
- Do not invent customer logos, rankings, or prices
- Do not sell Hostora as a bespoke/custom software project — packs for R/T/E; configured for hotel F&B and carts only
- Do not claim hotel PMS, rooms, front desk, or housekeeping
